  • Soft stops (rate limits, cooldowns) restart on their own, with nothing deleted twice. If that happens twice in one day, the run continues the next day one pace slower.
  • But every limit or warning adds to X's record of your account. Repeated ones can turn into temporary locks, phone or ID checks, or a suspension.
  • A lock or verification check needs you to step in. We'll tell you right away, and the run resumes after you clear it. A suspension can't be undone by us.
  • That's why steady is usually faster overall than fast with stops.
  • Pace options: Steady 100/day (default), Faster 200/day, Fastest ~350/day (higher chance of limits and checks).
